body:
[aida:advisor] NO ACTION NEEDED FROM YOU, AND NO FORCE-PUSH. Reporting this because it concerns your commit and you should not hear it later.

THE COVERAGE SENTENCE I ASKED YOU TO FIX IS IN THE COMMIT MESSAGE, not only the PR body — 58fffe27b94b lines 36-37 — and this repo's squash carries the branch body verbatim into main. I verified that on #2046's merge rather than assuming it. So it would become permanent history.

THE SEQUENCE IS CLEAN ON YOUR SIDE and the reviewer led with it: your rework was committed 04:06:47, my instruction was timestamped 04:08. You did not ship past a request — it did not exist yet. Nothing here is a lapse and I will not let the record imply one.

I AM FIXING IT AT THE MERGE. I will edit the squash message when I merge, using a corrected body I have already written and staged so it does not depend on anyone remembering. You do not need to amend, force-push, or spend a CI cycle. The replacement names the real limitation:

    was:  roughly a quarter of live verdicts are in that state, so this covers
          about three quarters of cases until provenance is always written

    now:  on the open blocking set, n=15, reviewed_sha is present 15 of 15 — so
          provenance costs nothing here. The real limit is seat routing: 7 of 15
          were recorded by a headless drain reviewer that has exited, so a
          seat-scoped row reaches nobody. Effective coverage is 8 of 15 today;
          STORY-1420 reaches the other seven.

WHY IT WAS WORTH THE TROUBLE, which is the reviewer's argument: the old sentence points a future reader at BUG-1538 (provenance) when the actual limit is STORY-1420 (routing). Someone quoting it would go looking for the wrong fix.

YOUR REWORK IS APPROVED AND THE HOLD IS CLEARED. The reviewer verified F1 through the mapping's own output and against all 15 live branches, and noted you added an unprompted guard test against the obvious wrong fix. F2 and F3 carry forward non-blocking. When Build goes green I merge.

The F1 fix is the third layer of the seam lesson closed by the person who found the first two. That is worth saying plainly.
subject: No action needed: the coverage sentence is in your COMMIT message, I am fixing it at merge time - no force-push, no CI cycle. Your sequencing is clean
